class Box { value = 1; }
function showBox(box: object) {
  Object.setPrototypeOf(box, null);
  console.log(box);
}
const box = new Box();
const alias = box;
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { value: 'Other' });
showBox(box);
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { value: 'Third' });
console.log(alias);
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { configurable: true, get() { throw new Error('name getter ran'); } });
showBox(new Box());
console.log(box);
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { value: 494 });
console.log(box);
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { value: '' });
console.log(box);
delete (Box as { name?: string }).name;
console.log(box);
class Base { value = 2; }
class Child extends Base { extra = 3; }
const child = new Child();
Object.defineProperty(Child, 'name', { value: 'RenamedChild' });
showBox(child);
Object.defineProperty(Box, 'name', { value: 'RestoredBox' });
const asPrototype = new Box();
showBox(asPrototype);
Object.create(asPrototype);
console.log(asPrototype);
const assignedPrototype = new Box();
Object.setPrototypeOf({}, assignedPrototype);
showBox(assignedPrototype);
delete (Box as { name?: string }).name;
class NamedBase {}
Object.setPrototypeOf(Box, NamedBase);
console.log(box);
Object.defineProperty(NamedBase, 'name', { value: 'InheritedName' });
console.log(box);
const nullDictionary = Object.create(null);
console.log(nullDictionary);
